newsitem.title: JAPAN: IOC buys four Dubai, others in tender -- traders.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys four Dubai, others in tender -- traders.

text.p: State-owned India Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded four Dubai cargoes, a 900,000 barrel parcel of Gulf of Suez, and one VLCC of Qua Iboe in its August buying crude tender, oil traders said Friday. Traders said IOC awarded one cargo of Dubai to Spanish Repsol at first-half quotes minus seven cts, one Dubai to Conoco at minus five cents and two Dubai cargoes to Statoil at minus six and minus seven cents.
Glencore was heard to have been awarded a 900,000 barrel parcel of Gulf of Suez at 25 cents above the official selling price.
Mobil was awarded one VLCC of Qua Iboe, traders said, but no price was disclosed.
